content: Identifying the ReferenceBase of a Relative Reference The appropriate ReferenceBase is identified by • the attribute base . This denotes the first containing ARPackage visible (the first ancestor package from the reference to the root of the model) from the reference which has a referenceBase with shortLabel equal to the base . In other words: as packages are nested the appropriate referenceBase is searched bottom up. • alternatively the innermost package which has a referenceBase with default set to true.
